name: Silicon Valley Career Technical Education (SVCTE)
what_you_do: Career classes while in high school: AI engineering, auto repair, healthcare, construction, HVAC, animation, fire science and more. Some give college credit or pre-apprenticeship.
who_can_apply: The page does not list eligibility. Ask your school counselor or call SVCTE.
deadline_text: Ask your counselor for enrollment dates.
how_to_apply: Talk to your school counselor. The page offers campus tours and shadow days. Phone 408-723-6403.
notes: More than 24 career pathways. Mentions dual enrollment, UC a-g courses and an ironworkers pre-apprenticeship. The page lists a Schedule of Fees without prices, so ask about costs. Grades, deadlines and eligibility not on the page.
